A new Counterpoint Research report shows Apple, Garmin, and Huawei bucking a market-wide decline in smartwatch shipments in Q2 2026, with Huawei reaching a record share of global shipments. Here are the details.

Apple records growth across all regions

In a new report published yesterday, Counterpoint Research says the smartwatch market saw a 4% year-over-year decline in global shipments in the second quarter of 2026.

According to the report, Apple saw the biggest jump, with shipments up 14% year over year and accounting for 20.1% of global smartwatch shipments. This kept Apple in second place, behind Huawei, which saw shipments grow 1% year over year and held a 21.8% share.

The ranking continues with Imoo, which held a 7.8% share despite a 3% year-over-year drop in shipments, followed by Xiaomi at 6.1% with a whopping 38% decline. Garmin held a 5.6% share after shipments grew 11%, while other brands collectively accounted for the remaining 38.5%, with shipments down 8% year over year.

The report also noted that Apple recorded the fastest growth among the top five brands in China for the quarter, “signaling its recovery following the decline seen in the same quarter of 2025,” with the country’s consumer electronics subsidy program also helping boost smartwatch sales.
